newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: West Rand aims for KalGold listing.
newsitem.headline: West Rand aims for KalGold listing.

text.p: West Rand Consolidated Mines Ltd said on Thursday that it aims to distribute to shareholders 18.4 percent of its Kalahari Goldridge Mining Co Ltd (KalGold) unit and then list the firm on the Johannesburg Stock Exchange.
West Rand said the listing would raise investor awareness of KalGold's main asset, the Goldridge Project. The project is an Archaean greenstone-hosted gold source that is rare in South Africa.
Exploration in the lease area has so far resulted in the discovery of 31 tonnes of gold with a further 34 tonnes categorised as inferred resources.
In the project's D Zone open pit there are 8.3 million tonnes of proven and probable reserves at an average grade of 1.65 grams a tonne.
The operation is currently producing gold at a daily rate which equates to some 70 kg of gold per month from a plant throughput of 80,000 tonnes of ore a month.
The firm said the operation was approaching the stage of being cash positive.
